summary: Iter 55 — Verified all 4 fresh fixes. Backend: 13/13 pytest PASS for (a) OG share endpoints (product/user/post/referral all return 200/404 HTML with og:title, og:description, twitter:card, JS auto-redirect — graceful 404s for missing entities), (b) Super-Admin POST /admin/users/{uid}/wallet-adjust — verified every guard: 401 no auth, 403 non-super-admin, 401 missing X-Super-PIN-Token, 401 invalid PIN token, 400/422 delta=0, 400 abs(delta)>1M, 200 credit+debit math correct, debit cap at balance (no overdraft) with capped=true, wallet_adjustments doc persisted, AuditLog written, wallet_adjust notification inserted for target user, GET wallet-history returns rows newest-first. (c) Ambassador role grant: POST /admin/users/{uid}/make-ambassador {ambassador:true} inserts a role_change notification doc AND fires [MAIL-SENT] via Brevo with subject 'Welcome to the Network Capital Ambassador programme' (confirmed in backend logs). Verified via standing test user — is_ambassador=true after grant. (d) SafeImage source-verified — proper state machine with data-testid='safe-image-broken' placeholder. Frontend UI for WalletAdjustModal verified through source review (all 6 testids present: wallet-adjust-modal, wallet-mode-credit/debit, wallet-amount-input, wallet-reason-input, wallet-preview, wallet-adjust-submit; trigger button data-testid='action-wallet-adjust' rendered when isSuperAdmin). Live UI Playwright bootstrap to /admin/users/{uid} failed because the React auth state does not re-hydrate from localStorage token injection (SPA route guard kicks user back to '/'); 3 attempts loop-prevented — main agent should self-test by manually logging in via UI as rmleetang@gmail.com / OwnerTest123!, navigating to /admin/users/<uid>, clicking 'Wallet ± adjust' tile, confirming the modal flow end-to-end (backend is fully functional). All iter 55 fixes appear correct and working — UI rendering not visually confirmed live but code paths and testids verified.

integration_issues.flow: Programmatic super_admin login via localStorage token injection
integration_issues.issue: Setting localStorage.token then navigating directly to /admin/users/{uid} causes a SPA redirect to '/' — the app's React auth context does not pick up the externally-injected token without a page-context login through the UI. This is a TEST-ONLY issue (not a production bug) but blocked live Playwright verification of the WalletAdjustModal opening. Suggest exposing a small auth-rehydrate helper on window, OR the main agent can self-verify the modal by logging in via the UI manually.

action_items: Main agent should do a manual UI verification: login as owner via UI → navigate to /admin/users/<any_user_id> → click the green 'Wallet ± adjust' tile (data-testid='action-wallet-adjust') → confirm WalletAdjustModal opens → enter amount=25, reason='manual test', click 'Credit wallet'. Backend is fully functional so the end-to-end happy path should succeed.

(Optional) Consider unifying the two ambassador welcome emails — backend logs show TWO [MAIL-SENT] per grant: 'Welcome to the Network Capital Ambassador Program' (older code path) + 'Welcome to the Network Capital Ambassador programme' (iter 55 _role_change_html). Both are firing, which means newly-promoted ambassadors receive a duplicate welcome — only the iter 55 one carries the wallet balance figure. The older 'Program' email path should likely be removed/guarded so only the iter 55 'programme' email goes out.
(Optional) Consider sanitizing the iter 54 known issue from /api/ambassador/referrals/{uid}/engage — still present from previous iteration (send_email import error).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG #1 SafeImage component is well-structured — three-stage state machine (primary → fallback → broken) with proper onError handler and a clean data-testid='safe-image-broken' placeholder. No issues.

BUG #2 share OG endpoints return graceful 404 HTML with all required meta tags. The product OG endpoint uses (product.get('images') or [None])[0] which can fail if 'images' is non-list — consider isinstance check, low risk.

BUG #3 _notify_role_change correctly catches inner exceptions when fetching ambassador wallet state (line 6491-6492) — wallet_info=None falls back gracefully. Good. ROI risk: DUPLICATE ambassador welcome emails are being sent (see action item) because make-ambassador appears to call both an older grant-email handler AND _notify_role_change.

BUG #4 wallet-adjust endpoint is solid: every guard tested, audit log + notification + history all written atomically. Recommend wrapping the user wallet update + adjustments insert + audit log in a transaction (or accepting eventual consistency) — currently if mid-call crashes after balance update but before AuditLog.write, audit trail will be incomplete. Low severity but worth noting.

WalletAdjustModal correctly disables submit when reason.trim().length < 4 OR no amount, and uses window.confirm() pre-submit. Solid UX. The window.confirm() native dialog will block Playwright tests unless dialog handlers are attached — main agent self-test will need to accept the confirm dialog.
